actions.reason: C0001 shows a coherent metabolic-downregulation transcriptomic program with strong effect sizes and low q-values, no set-level technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries to all other sets. Structure is compatible and no competing explanation is supported, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has a PBRM1-enriched mutation profile with significant large-effect genes and a directionally consistent metabolic-up RNA trend, no technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries. Identity is supported and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 shows convergent strong immune-inflamed RNA programs and BAP1 mutation enrichment, no significant technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries to all sets. Identity is coherent and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has a coherent VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wildtype mutation-defined identity with strong WXS-driven internal structure, no technical confounding, and positive fused boundaries. Identity is supported and structure is compatible, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 has strong PBRM1 mutation enrichment supporting a biological identity and positive fused boundaries, but significant set-level associations with tissue source site and scanner model constitute a plausible competing technical explanation. The candidate remains defensible for downstream validation, with the technical confound flagged as a material limitation.

C0006 has only limited biological support, driven mainly by a single MUC16 enrichment in a large passenger-prone gene with no RNA signal, but no technical confounding and positive fused boundaries. Identity is uncertain yet the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0007 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype mutation-defined identity with strong WXS-driven internal structure and positive fused boundaries, but a significant scanner-model association provides a plausible competing technical explanation. The candidate remains defensible for downstream validation, with the technical confound flagged as a material limitation.
